local_results_filtering.rule: Result filters for fields present in normalized loaded results filter that loaded set immediately. A facet is exposed only when the currently loaded normalized payload has complete data for that facet. New Tourvisor searches are reserved for real primary search-input changes or separately justified background expansion.
